title: Indonesian tin miner eyes mining asset in Canada
body: Arsari Tambang says it will take advantage of an economic partnership deal signed with Canada last month to invest in a mining asset there.

title: Column: Tin breaks higher as Indonesia cracks down on illegal miners
body: The tin market is once again bubbling on supply chain trouble, this time in Indonesia.

title: Central Omega Resources Reports Record Production and Profit Surge in H1 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk reported a 140% jump in nickel ore production to 1.73 Mt and a 159% rise in sales to 1.83 Mt in the first half of 2025, driving net profit to Rp310.3 bn and EBITDA to Rp481.4 bn, up 38% and 219% respectively. The gains were attributed to full‑scale mining operations resumed after the 2024 RKAB, with the company optimistic for continued growth amid stable global nickel prices but wary of US tariff uncertainties.

title: Merdeka Battery Reports 78% Surge in Nickel Ore Production in H1 2025, Despite 32% Revenue Drop, While Advancing Smelter and HPAL Projects
body: In the first half of 2025, Merdeka Battery’s nickel ore output climbed 78% to 6.9 Mt wmt, driven by 45% growth in limonite and 189% in saprolite, even as revenue fell 32% to US$628 M. The company cut NPI cost below US$10,000/ton, sold 9,465 t of MHP via Train A, and progressed its 90,000 t/yr HPAL at Sulawesi Nickel Cobalt to 29% completion, while EBITDA rose 33% YoY in Q2 after trimming HGNM output.
